text: D Mart sold eighteen percent more last quarter.
But its profit grew only seven point six percent.
Did it cut prices? No. The gross margin barely moved.
But last year it opened eighty five stores. It used to open about fifty.
So depreciation is up twenty six percent, and interest is up eighty seven.
And borrowings nearly tripled in six months, to two thousand six hundred and twenty nine crore rupees.
